ucs.title: [LLM] HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon ProxyLogon webshell drop via Exchange w3wp.exe
ucs.description: Detects China Chopper-class ASPX/ASHX webshells dropped by the Exchange IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) into OWA, ECP, or aspnet_client directories — the signature post-exploit action of HAFNIUM (Silk Typhoon) following the CVE-2021-26855/26857/26858/27065 ProxyLogon chain that Microsoft attributed to this actor in March 2021.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_name values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ashx") AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\aspnet_client\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\FrontEnd\\HttpProxy\\owa\\auth\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\FrontEnd\\HttpProxy\\ecp\\auth\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ClientAccess\\Owa\\auth\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ClientAccess\\Owa\\Current\\themes\\resources\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".ashx"
| where FolderPath has_any (
    @"\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\",
    @"\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\",
    @"\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\ecp\auth\",
    @"\ClientAccess\Owa\auth\",
    @"\ClientAccess\Owa\Current\themes\resources\"
  )
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActingProcessName endswith "w3wp.exe"
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("aspx","ashx")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (
    @"\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\",
    @"\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\",
    @"\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\ecp\auth\",
    @"\ClientAccess\Owa\auth\",
    @"\ClientAccess\Owa\Current\themes\resources\"
  )
| where ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName,
          ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon Exchange Webshell Drop (ProxyLogon Post-Exploit)
id: 7b21a014-e8c4-4d9f-8a3e-2f4c1b6e7c01
status: experimental
description: Detects China Chopper-class ASPX/ASHX webshells written by the Exchange IIS worker (w3wp.exe) into OWA/ECP auth or aspnet_client paths — the signature post-ProxyLogon (CVE-2021-26855 chain) artefact attributed by Microsoft to HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2021/03/02/hafnium-targeting-exchange-servers-0-day-exploits/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.g0125
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.ashx'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\'
      - '\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\'
      - '\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\ecp\auth\'
      - '\ClientAccess\Owa\auth\'
      - '\ClientAccess\Owa\Current\themes\resources\'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_ext and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Microsoft Exchange cumulative updates and security hot-fixes that legitimately stage ASPX files into these paths via the Exchange installer (correlate to KB/CU rollout windows)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\w3wp.exe OR *\W3WP.exe OR *\W3WP.EXE) (@TargetFilename:*.aspx OR @TargetFilename:*.ASPX OR @TargetFilename:*.ashx OR @TargetFilename:*.ASHX) (@TargetFilename:*\inetpub\wwwroot\aspnet_client\* OR @TargetFilename:*\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\* OR @TargetFilename:*\FrontEnd\HttpProxy\ecp\auth\* OR @TargetFilename:*\ClientAccess\Owa\auth\* OR @TargetFilename:*\inetpub\wwwroot\ASPNET_CLIENT\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/\\w3wp\.exe$/i
| TargetFileName=/\.(aspx|ashx)$/i
| regex("\\\\(inetpub\\\\wwwroot\\\\aspnet_client|FrontEnd\\\\HttpProxy\\\\(owa|ecp)\\\\auth|ClientAccess\\\\Owa\\\\auth|ClientAccess\\\\Owa\\\\Current\\\\themes\\\\resources)\\\\", field=TargetFileName, flags="i")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextProcessId], function=count())
ucs.rationale: HAFNIUM's CVE-2021-26855 ProxyLogon chain ends with an authenticated arbitrary file write via the Exchange Unified Messaging service, dropping JScript China-Chopper webshells into OWA/ECP virtual directories. Microsoft's HAFNIUM advisory enumerated these exact paths (\aspnet_client\, \FrontEnd\HttpProxy\owa\auth\) and named webshells (e.g., RedirSuiteServerProxy.aspx, XsIarR.aspx, OutlookEN.aspx).

ucs.title: [LLM] HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon webshell-to-credential-theft chain (w3wp.exe spawning recon, LSASS dump, NTDS staging)
ucs.description: Detects post-webshell HAFNIUM tradecraft where the Exchange IIS worker spawns command interpreters that execute the actor's documented recon/credential-theft toolkit — procdump or comsvcs.dll MiniDump against LSASS, vssadmin/ntdsutil for NTDS.dit extraction, 7z staging, and exfil to MEGA — all parented by w3wp.exe, an extremely unusual pattern outside compromise.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_name) as proc_name values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","makecab.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","vssadmin.exe","ntdsutil.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*lsass*","*comsvcs.dll*MiniDump*","*ntds.dit*","*vssadmin*create*shadow*","*mega.nz*","*mega.io*","*-accepteula*","*Invoke-Mimikatz*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","makecab.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","vssadmin.exe","ntdsutil.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass","comsvcs.dll","MiniDump","ntds.dit","vssadmin create shadow","mega.nz","mega.io","-accepteula","Invoke-Mimikatz","sekurlsa")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessId
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","makecab.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","vssadmin.exe","ntdsutil.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ParentProcessName endswith "w3wp.exe"
| where tolower(tostring(split(TargetProcessName,"\\")[-1])) in (SuspChildren)
   or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass","comsvcs.dll","MiniDump","ntds.dit","vssadmin create shadow","mega.nz","mega.io","-accepteula","Invoke-Mimikatz","sekurlsa")
| where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("MSExchangeOWAAppPool","MSExchangeECPAppPool","MSExchangeServicesAppPool","MSExchangeRpcProxyAppPool","MSExchangeAutodiscoverAppPool")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\w3wp.exe OR *\W3WP.exe OR *\W3WP.EXE) (@Image:(*\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\procdump.exe OR *\procdump64.exe OR *\Procdump.exe OR *\7z.exe OR *\7za.exe OR *\makecab.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\whoami.exe OR *
ltest.exe OR *\vssadmin.exe OR *
tdsutil.exe OR *undll32.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR * itsadmin.exe OR *
et.exe OR *
et1.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*lsass* OR *LSASS* OR *comsvcs.dll* OR *MiniDump* OR *ntds.dit* OR *NTDS.dit* OR *"vssadmin create shadow"* OR *mega.nz* OR *mega.io* OR *sekurlsa* OR *Invoke-Mimikatz*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^w3wp\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|procdump(64)?|7za?|makecab|wmic|net1?|whoami|nltest|systeminfo|vssadmin|ntdsutil|rundll32|certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i OR regex("(lsass|comsvcs\\.dll|MiniDump|ntds\\.dit|vssadmin create shadow|mega\\.(nz|io)|sekurlsa|Invoke-Mimikatz)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Microsoft, Volexity, FireEye/Mandiant, and CrowdStrike all documented HAFNIUM's post-ProxyLogon playbook: drop a webshell, then issue commands via the webshell so the Exchange IIS worker (w3wp.exe with MSExchange*AppPool identity) becomes the parent of cmd.exe -> procdump.exe lsass.exe / rundll32.exe comsvcs.dll MiniDump / vssadmin create shadow + ntdsutil for NTDS.dit / 7z archives staged in C:\P
